ts-node.observedGap: @medusajs/cli@2.22.1 exits with Cannot find module 'ts-node' before any host command.
alternativesConsidered: Declare exact ts-node in both CLI-consuming packages
ts-node.decision: Declare ts-node@10.9.2 exactly; the official plugin build, seed command, and Medusa integration runner require the CLI and must not depend on undeclared global state.

admin-build.observedGap: The official Medusa plugin build compiled the backend, then Rollup could not resolve the generated @medusajs/admin-shared import; the frontend also imports @medusajs/admin-sdk directly.
alternativesConsidered: Declare the official SDK peer/dev dependency and exact build dependency
admin-build.decision: Declare @medusajs/admin-sdk@2.22.1 as dev and peer, and @medusajs/admin-shared@2.22.1 as an exact dev build dependency. Central environment verification and lock update remain required before claiming the admin build green.

host-module-mode.observedGap: The Medusa 2.22.1 CLI rejected examples/medusa/medusa-config.ts with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM when the standalone host package declared type=module.
alternativesConsidered: Rename and rewrite configuration around the loader
Use the CommonJS package mode required by the official loader
host-module-mode.decision: Remove type=module from the standalone example host package. The plugin package remains ESM.
